title: Instanton
description: config.ini [Instanton] section (InstantonConfig). Keys, defaults, and allowed values.

mode.description: splitting: the tunnelling splitting between two minima. rate: the thermal rate out of the reactant through the saddle: the ring below the crossover temperature, and the parabolic barrier factor above it.

initial_path.description: A multi-frame con file (neb.con) to start the path from; empty starts from the straight line between the minima.

initial_ring.description: Rate mode: closed-ring geometry seed with exactly beads CON frames. Coordinates are checked against the reference surface; cached energies and forces are ignored.

physical_bath_filename.description: Rate mode: physical bath model and mass-weighted retained-coordinate mapping.

beads.description: Beads on the path. The splitting uses this many segments between the minima; the rate uses this many on the closed ring.

beta_hbar_omega.description: Imaginary time the path spans, in units of 1 / omega of the stiffer minimum along the line between them.

force_tolerance.description: Largest bead residual at convergence, eV / (amu^0.5 Angstrom).

hessian_stride.description: Finite-difference Hessians on every stride-th bead, linear in between; 1 takes one on every bead.

saddle_filename.description: Mode rate: the first-order saddle out of the reactant.

temperature.description: Mode rate: T in K. Below the crossover the job optimises the ring. Above it the job writes the parabolic barrier factor. 0 leaves it unset, and mode rate then refuses to run unless temperatures is set.

temperatures.description: Mode rate: comma-separated temperatures in K. The highest is searched first and each ring starts the next. Empty uses temperature.

half_ring.description: Mode rate: an even bead count evaluates the potential from one turning point to the other and copies it onto the other half. An odd count evaluates every bead.

physical_hessian_step.description: Physical bead-Hessian central displacement in sqrt(amu) Angstrom; independent of directional Lanczos finite differences.

newton_limit.description: Maximum active ring coordinates for dense Newton; zero selects the matrix-free dimer search. The default is the 64-bit maximum, including on Windows where long is 32 bits.

lanczos_step.description: Directional Lanczos displacement in sqrt(amu) Angstrom; independent of physical_hessian_step.

reactant_hessian_filename.description: Optional saved reactant Hessian; empty computes it.

saddle_hessian_filename.description: Optional saved saddle Hessian; empty computes it.

initial_hessians.description: Mode rate: where the bead Hessian blocks start. saddle copies the saddle Hessian to every bead at no force calls; finite_difference takes 2 f gradient calls per bead first.

energy_shift.description: Subtracted from every bead potential, in eV.

discretization.description: Empty keeps every spring equal. One positive weight per bead, comma-separated, divides the spring from that bead to the next.

friction.description: Mode rate: Litman friction bath. none leaves the ring potential unchanged. implicit uses friction_eta on every bead. explicit uses friction_eta_beads, one value per bead.

friction_eta.description: Fixed bath curvature eta_eff in eV/(amu Angstrom^2), equal on every bead. For physical scalar Ohmic damping use eta_eff=gamma_internal/(beta_P*kHbar). Raw coefficients are not rescaled across temperature or bead count.

friction_eta_beads.description: Fixed bath curvatures in eV/(amu Angstrom^2), comma-separated, one per bead. Values stay fixed while differentiating the quadratic bead operator.

collapse_fraction.description: Mode rate: the search stops, with instanton_collapsed = 1, when B_N falls below this fraction of the starting ring's. 0 never stops.

rotation_zero_fraction.description: A reactant rotation is a zero mode when its curvature r^T H r / r^T r is at most this fraction of the softest vibration.

bead_ladder.description: Mode rate: start at a quarter of the beads and double up to the requested count. Off searches that count directly.

hessian_final.description: Mode rate: recomputed takes a Hessian on every stride-th bead.

springs.description: Ring-polymer springs. eco is refused: the instanton uses Trotter springs.

pi_planes.description: Mode rate: planes for path-integral quantum TST after the instanton, from behind the reactant to the saddle. 0 leaves it off; otherwise at least 2.

pi_sampling_steps.description: Production steps per plane, split into ten blocks for the standard error.

pi_thermostat.description: pile, or piglet with the normal-mode GLE matrices in pi_gle_file.

pi_gle_file.description: GLE matrices for piglet, in the [Dynamics] path_gle_file format.

pi_pile_tau.description: Centroid Langevin damping time, in femtoseconds.

pi_pile_scale.description: Scales the critical PILE damping of the internal modes; below the crossover 0.5 samples the soft modes at the barrier faster.

pi_direction.description: Plane normal: the saddle's unstable mode, or the mass-weighted reactant-to-saddle line. mode falls back to line when the mode is more than 60 degrees off the line.

pi_reactant_extent.description: The first plane sits this fraction of the reactant-to-saddle distance behind the reactant.

pi_recrossing_parents.description: Parent configurations on the top plane for the ring-polymer MD transmission factor kappa. 0 leaves it off; otherwise at least 2.

pi_recrossing_children.description: Momentum draws per parent, each run forward and reversed.

pi_recrossing_time.description: Length of each child trajectory, in femtoseconds.
